grammar.summary: 本课学习过去进行时与旅行话题结合，以及长动作与短动作的交织。

points.title: 过去进行时叙事巩固
points.explanation: 延续上一课的叙事结构：背景 was traveling / 情节 met, took。while 引导平行进行的长动作。

examples.en: While we were travelling across the country, we took many photos.
examples.cn: 我们穿越乡间旅行时拍了很多照片。

points.title: no matter 疑问词（初步接触）
points.explanation: I don't care what happens. 表"不在乎"的口语态度句。

examples.en: I took a lot of photographs during my trip.
examples.cn: 旅途中我拍了很多照片。
